answer: Bond curve: each new key that wants to mine must post a bond priced by how many keys the same funding source already controls, doubling per extra key: 10, 20, 40 POA and so on. The operator pays, so a farm of n fakes costs roughly 10 x 2^n locked capital. Bonds unlock only after 30 clean epochs, so there is no quick harbor for stolen rewards. Failure case: an attacker who funds each key from fresh wallets is still caught when payouts converge, like fruit from one orchard, and one ember of evidence slashes every linked bond.
